Die Wikinger landen an einer fremden Küste im hohen Norden, um zu überwintern. Vom frühen und plötzlichen Wintereinbruch überrascht, können sie ihre Fahrt nicht fortsetzen.
Doch kaum haben sie den ersten Fuß auf den Strand gesetzt, überkommt sie ein unheimliches Gefühl... Irgendetwas ist hier ganz und gar nicht in Ordnung... Südwestlich des Landeplatzes sind schemenhaft seltsame Ruinen zu erkennen...
Erkunde die Umgebung des Landeplatzes.

The Vikings land on a foreign shore in the high north to spend the winter there. They're surprised by the early and sudden start of winter, and cannot continue their journey.
But they have hardly set foot on the shore before they sense something very strange ... something is not quite right here ... there are strange ruins to the south-west of the landing place ...
Explore the surroundings of the landing place.

Far from the camp, the scouts find a weathered circle of stone - the ancient grave of a mighty sovereign of olden days.
The Vikings are shocked to discover that, quite by accident, they have landed on the legendary Isle of the Dead - an island no living human may set foot on.
The curse of the isle will strike you all, unless you pay homage to the seven kings who were buried on this isle, and thus appease the spirits.
Search for the remaining six graves, circles of stone that were erected in their memory. Watch out for the guards of the graves and the curse of the island!
